Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub.: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Audio Link for Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings 
Conference Call 
Further to our intimation dated 27 October, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part 
Aof Schedule I11 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
please note that the Audio Link for Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call with the 
Analysts/Investors on the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the 
Company for the 2% Quarter and Half Year ended 30 September, 2026 conducted through digital 
means on Friday, 30 October, 2026 at 6:00 P.M. (1.S.T) is available on the website of the Company 
under the following link: https://ramkrishnaforgings.com/audio-video-recording-earning-call 
We request you to kindly take the abovementioned information on record and oblige. 
Thanking you. 
Yours faithfully, 
For Ramkrishna Forgings Limited
